name: Smartphone no Mukougawa no Kanojo ~Saikin, Kaiwachuu no Kanojo no Yousu ga Okashii…~
original_name: スマホの向こう側の彼女～最近、会話中の彼女の様子がおかしい…～
source: The day after the practice match. When they meet at school, she seems a little nervous and is acting differently than usual… Even on the phone at night, her voice is high-pitched… It gets worse with each passing day…
translation: 练习赛后的第二天。在学校见面的时候，她显得有些紧张，举止也和平常不一样……即使是晚上打电话，声音也很高调……一天比一天严重……
